Why Do We Yawn? The Brain-Cooling Mystery! — Seeing someone yawn makes YOU yawn in two seconds flat! But why does your mouth stretch open so wide?
Kids science answer for "why do we yawn kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Yawns are not just about being sleepy; a deep yawn rushes cool air into our head to cool down our hardworking brain like a computer fan!
